desc: The LVL 2 Slim Holster is an outside the waistband holster with level 2 retention. This latest addition to our Rapid Force holster line is built for those needing a more compact holster while maintaining compatibility with their current Rapid Force Quick Disconnect System. The LVL 2 Slim is the perfect partner to the Level 3 Duty Holster and is great for unmarked or off-duty work. This holster meets the needs of detectives, executive protection, and officers both on and off the job.
